remarks: Welcome to Prospect Park.This completely renovated duplex, with hardwood floors, all new appliances, washer and dryer in unit, a very large private terrace off the bedrooms and much more. located in the heart of Downtown Stamford. Short walk to Metro North and Steps to weekend farmers market, Library, medical facilitates, UCONN and some of the finest restaurants in Fairfield County. Pet friendly and underground parking is available. Heat, Hot water and cooking gas included
